definitions.gloss: frank advice; candid criticism (unwelcome but well meant)
definitions.explanation: Advice or criticism that is unpleasant to hear but given for the listener's own good, often by someone senior or by a commentator speaking plainly about a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{苦言|くげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呈|てい}する→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧。
examples.english: I give my subordinate some frank advice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦言|くげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧になって⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}った→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: My senior's blunt advice has turned out to be useful now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遅|おそ}すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{苦言|くげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呈|てい}した→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧。
examples.english: The experts criticized the government frankly, saying its measures had come too late.

notes:
{苦|く} (bitter) + {言|げん} (words): bitter words, as in the proverb {良薬|りょうやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{苦|にが}し (good medicine tastes bitter). The fixed verb is ⟦{呈|てい}する→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧; {苦言|くげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ is heard in speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苦言|くげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呈|てい}する→呈する：12003_teisuru⟧: to offer frank criticism
- {苦言|くげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}める→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧: to take blunt advice to heart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧: advice, warning — neutral; {苦言|くげん} stresses that it is hard to hear
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧: criticism — need not be for the listener's good
